Temporal-network user guide
===========================

This guide explains how to build temporal networks, choose measures and
interpret outputs with **tnet_analysis 1.0.2**. Start with small examples
before scaling to many nodes, frames or subjects.

The workflow is: signals (optional) → connectivity (optional) → binary
network frames → measures. Synthetic networks can enter at the network stage.
All examples use generated data and need no external dataset.

.. only:: html

   Offline reading: :download:`Download the PDF user guide <../output/pdf/tnet_analysis-1.0.2-user-guide.pdf>`.

The toolbox is distributed under the MIT license. Docstrings specify accepted
inputs; this guide adds workflow and interpretation advice.
